note: Equity STCG and LTCG for the swing research account. STT is assumed paid, so sections 111A and 112A apply. Surcharge is not charged: the account's other income is unknown. Cess is applied on the capital-gains tax. Every row is unverified: no assessment order was checked. A row is the schedule from that date.

rows.note: Section 111A charges STCG at 15% where STT is paid. Section 10(38) exempts the matching LTCG for transfers before 1 April 2018. Cess is 2% education plus 1% secondary and higher education. Surcharge is omitted.

sources.stcg: Income-tax Act, 1961, section 111A, before the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 amendment
sources.ltcg: Section 10(38), withdrawn for transfers on or after 1 April 2018 by the Finance Act, 2018. UNVERIFIED: the gazette was not opened
sources.cess: Education cess 2% and secondary and higher education cess 1%, before the Health and Education Cess. UNVERIFIED

rows.note: Section 112A taxes LTCG above Rs 1 lakh at 10% for transfers on or after 1 April 2018. Cost of a lot bought before 1 February 2018 is grandfathered to the 31 January 2018 close. Health and Education Cess is 4%. Surcharge is omitted.

sources.ltcg: Income-tax Act section 112A as inserted by the Finance Act, 2018. UNVERIFIED: the gazette was not opened
sources.grandfather: Section 112A explanation: higher of actual cost and the lower of fair market value on 31 January 2018 and the sale price. UNVERIFIED
sources.cess: Finance Act, 2018, Health and Education Cess 4% from FY 2018-19. UNVERIFIED

rows.note: The LTCG exemption becomes Rs 1.25 lakh for FY 2024-25. The rate stays 10% until 23 July 2024. CBDT says the higher exemption applies to the whole year.
Transfers on or after 23 July 2024: STCG 20% under section 111A, LTCG 12.5% under section 112A, exemption still Rs 1.25 lakh for the financial year. Surcharge is omitted.

sources.act: https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/w/section-112a-60 section 112A, and section 111A as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024
